title: Healthcare Software Case Studies | Elevate Aura
meta: Three real platforms shipped by Elevate Aura: a medical equipment operations platform, an e-commerce and distributor platform, and an exam preparation app.
h1: Three platforms, built and shipped by one builder.
sub: Elevate Aura publishes only work that actually shipped. Three projects: an operations platform for a medical-equipment distributor, an e-commerce and distributor platform for a medical robotics company, and its own exam-preparation product on Google Play.
meta_ticks: Live in 30 working days where scope allows
whatsapp_text: Hi, I read your case studies and want to discuss a platform for our business.
persona: Owner evaluating whether Elevate Aura has actually shipped platforms like the one they need

paras: Three projects, each built and shipped end to end by the founder, Ragul Sekar, from Chennai. A 12-module operations platform for a medical-equipment distribution business. An e-commerce and distributor platform with 253 product and city landing pages for a medical robotics company. And Elevate Aura's own government-exam-preparation product, live on Google Play.

Nothing else appears here. There are no logos from work that was scoped but not shipped, and no figures that cannot be pointed at. What each page gives you instead is the modules that were built, the stack they were built on, what each part replaced, and how the work ran.
Two of the three became products. Aura Business grew out of the distribution platform, and Aura Learn grew out of the exam-prep app.

sections.h2: Three builds, three different shapes of problem.

items.p: Medical-equipment distribution, Chennai. A 12-module operations platform with a field-staff app, manager dashboard, GST billing, payment tracking and service tracking, on React Native, Supabase and WordPress, shipped in 30 days.

Medical robotics, Chennai. A storefront, distributor portal, quotations, distributor ordering and UTR payment verification, plus 253 product and city SEO pages across four product lines, on Supabase, JavaScript and Playwright.
Elevate Aura's own product. An Android app live on Google Play with Telegram practice bots and content automation, on Flutter, Python and Supabase. The origin of Aura Learn.

sections.h2: The same framework on every build.

items.p: Discovery settles what is in and what is not before anything is built. A fixed scope is what makes a 30-day timeline meaningful.
Modules and screens are shaped to the existing way of working, with your branding across the dashboard, the app and the invoices.
Existing Excel data becomes the starting records, so nobody retypes a customer list to begin.
Ragul Sekar scopes, builds, ships and supports each platform himself, so there is no handover between teams.
Direct on WhatsApp, and in person in Chennai. No ticket queue and no account-management layer.
Where scope allows, with the timeline for your project stated in the scope document.
Product and city pages at scale.
Choosing the right kind of software.
